meta.title: Thial · Handmade candles that turn stories into scents
meta.description: Thial makes handmade candles inspired by people, places, moments and experiences. Stories you can feel.

hero.concept: Your story is still being written.
hero.intro: We make handmade candles that turn stories, places and moments into scents.
hero.imageAlt: A lit Thial candle in a hand-painted ceramic vessel, next to its box.

essence.title: The essence of Thial
paragraphs: Thial was born from one idea: our story is made of moments that change us. Of people, places, experiences and instants that leave a mark and become memories.
We want everyone who lights a candle to find something of their own: a memory, a feeling, a place, someone special, or simply a sensation that is hard to explain.
essence.quote: The story belongs to Thial, but its meaning can belong to whoever receives it.

items.title: Concept
items.text: Your story is still being written.

items.title: Philosophy
items.text: Learning to live while we keep discovering who we are.

items.title: Purpose
items.text: Letting memories, experiences and lessons be felt again through scent, leaving room for each person to find something of their own.

items.title: Promise
items.text: To inspire you to look at what you have lived, discover what it left you, and keep writing your own story.

items.name: Connection
items.text: The bridge between Thial's story and the personal story of whoever experiences the scent.

items.name: Authenticity
items.text: Our collections come from real stories and experiences, told from a genuine place.

items.name: Creativity
items.text: We turn stories, places and emotions into scents and experiences that can be felt.

items.name: Sensitivity
items.text: We notice and value the small moments that can become memories.

items.name: Meaning
items.text: Each candle is more than pretty or fragrant: it has something to tell and something to leave.

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: We organise our candles by where their stories come from.
collections.thread: From this person I learned… / This experience left me…

candles.title: Candles
candles.question: What story does this scent remind you of?
candles.intro: Each candle has a name, a scent, a phrase and a card that tells what inspired it.
candles.placeholderNote: Sample names and scents while we prepare the collections.

items.question: Are the candles personalised?
items.answer: No. Each story comes from Thial and from the experiences that inspired its founder. Whoever receives the candle may find their own connection in it.

items.question: What comes with each candle?
items.answer: Each candle comes with its name, its scent, a short phrase and a card that tells what inspired it and what that story left behind.

items.question: How are the collections organised?
items.answer: By where their stories come from: people, places, moments and experiences.

items.question: How do I care for my candle?
items.answer: On the first burn, let the wax melt all the way to the edges. Trim the wick before each use and never leave a lit candle unattended.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Message us on Instagram or WhatsApp. We will tell you which candles are available and the delivery options.

buy.title: How to buy
buy.intro: For now, we handle every order personally.

steps.title: Choose your candle
steps.text: Explore the collections and find the story that speaks to you.

steps.title: Message us
steps.text: Send us a message on Instagram or WhatsApp with the candle you chose.

steps.title: Receive it
steps.text: We agree on payment and delivery together.
